title: Z.ai launches GLM-5.4, a 750B-parameter flagship model built on its Loop Transformer architecture, reaching intelligence levels comparable to 2T-3T models (Z.ai)
summary: Z.ai: Z.ai launches GLM-5.4, a 750B-parameter flagship model built on its Loop Transformer architecture, reaching intelligence levels comparable to 2T-3T models — Over the past three months, we have aggressively scaled both loop depth and model size in parallel. The first surprise came from the Loop Transformer architecture itself.
